Accepted reader repair of the a.e. multiplier quantifier after checking Roberts–Rosenthal §3.4 p.22. Verified finite probability kernel, one-step Lebesgue access, exclusion of positive-mass cycles by self-loops except at pi-null state 1, and infinitely many almost-sure finite refresh waits. Independent uniform refresh draws hit any positive-Lebesgue set almost surely. Density 1/(2 sqrt x) integrates to one and holding plus refresh parts give pi P=pi. All-start convergence theorem applies. For every 0<r<1, B_r=(0,(1-r)^2) has pi mass 1-r; any full-measure finite-M bound must apply at some x there. Atom probability (1-sqrt x)^n then exceeds every finite multiple of r^n eventually. No arbitrary single null-state witness is used.
